source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 以军士兵把枪口对准中国记者
topics.official_english: Israeli soldiers reportedly aim weapons at a Chinese journalist
topics.why_hot: The reported incident has triggered concern about the safety of Chinese journalists operating in conflict areas.
topics.share_angle: Examine the pressures on journalists in conflict zones and why this moment resonates with Chinese audiences.

topics.chinese_topic: 台风橙色预警！白海豚逼近浙闽沿海
topics.official_english: Orange alert issued as Typhoon White Dolphin approaches China's Zhejiang-Fujian coast
topics.why_hot: A severe-weather warning is active as Typhoon White Dolphin moves toward Zhejiang and Fujian; many are tracking the storm.
topics.share_angle: Explain what an orange typhoon warning means and how coastal cities prepare for the impact.

topics.chinese_topic: 大爷听AI洒农药 150亩苗一夜枯萎
topics.official_english: Elderly farmer loses 150 mu of seedlings after following AI pesticide advice
topics.why_hot: The story combines a surprising rural technology failure with real agricultural stakes, sparking debate about AI reliability.
topics.share_angle: Use it as a cautionary tale about unverified AI advice in agriculture and the need for oversight.

topics.chinese_topic: 孙子考取上海交大 爷爷感谢亲家母
topics.official_english: Grandfather thanks grandson's maternal grandmother after university admission
topics.why_hot: A warm family moment involving top university admission struck a chord because education is seen as a family achievement.
topics.share_angle: Frame it as a heartwarming look at family support and the value placed on education in China.

topics.chinese_topic: “未录满”本科专业排行榜出炉
topics.official_english: Ranking of undergraduate majors left unfilled in admission released
topics.why_hot: With admissions wrapping up, students and parents are eager to see which majors are less competitive and what that says about career prospects.
topics.share_angle: Explain how the list reflects changing student preferences and what under-enrollment means for universities.

topics.chinese_topic: 这种手机壳可能是医疗垃圾做的
topics.official_english: Phone cases may be made from medical waste, report says
topics.why_hot: The idea that everyday phone accessories might be made from discarded medical materials is alarming and quickly spread online.
topics.share_angle: Use it as a consumer watchdog story: how to avoid hazardous accessories and what regulators should check.

topics.chinese_topic: 上交绝杀清华 姚明笑出表情包
topics.official_english: Shanghai Jiao Tong beats Tsinghua with buzzer-beater; Yao Ming's reaction goes viral
topics.why_hot: A dramatic buzzer-beater between two elite universities and Yao Ming's meme-worthy reaction made it a fun crossover of sports and internet culture.
topics.share_angle: Present it as a light-hearted sports story and a window into China's growing college basketball scene.

topics.official_english: Automakers bring back physical buttons in car interiors
topics.why_hot: Drivers have long complained about touch screens and voice controls; the switch back to buttons taps into a broader debate on usability and safety.
topics.share_angle: Explore why car companies changed course and what it means for driver experience and automotive design.
